name: Implementation service
audience: Teams planning one bounded workflow change
scope: A proposed configuration, handover and acceptance process
unknowns: Whether the current systems and permissions support the change
Whether the proposed acceptance and rollback process is feasible
boundaries: Configuration is not evidence of adoption or business impact
Migration, integrations and ongoing support must be explicitly scoped

sections.prompt: Who will operate and own the changed workflow?
Which concrete workflow step needs changing?
What observable capability should exist after handover? Avoid guaranteed savings.
What configuration, dependencies, test, handover and acceptance steps are included?
What migrations, integrations, support periods or custom development are excluded?
How is the task currently done and what would switching disrupt?
Which actual observations support or challenge this implementation? Separate assumptions.
Which dependency and acceptance test must be checked before committing?
